name: dimi
description: Dimi's engineering toolkit for Claude Code. A reviewer-grade development loop (plan from a ticket, state-complete UI, pre-commit self-review, ship, address review, compound learnings into rules) with hooks and agents, plus forward-deployed engineering for LLM agents (harness reference, production-readiness review, MCP hardening, client profiles, fact refresh).

ticket_regex.title: Ticket key regex
ticket_regex.description: Regex a ticket key must match in branch names and commit messages, e.g. PROJ-[0-9]+ or ABC-[0-9]+. Used by the Bash guard and the session banner.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch work is diffed against and may never be pushed to directly (default: main).

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Pipe-separated branch names the Bash guard refuses to push to (default: main|master|production).

typecheck_script.title: Typecheck script name
typecheck_script.description: package.json script run per touched package by the Stop gate (default: typecheck). Leave empty to disable the typecheck gate.

typecheck_fallback.title: Whole-repo typecheck fallback
typecheck_fallback.description: Command run when no touched package has the script, e.g. pnpm exec tsc -b. Prefer incremental. Empty = no fallback.

typecheck_budget_s.title: Typecheck budget (seconds)
typecheck_budget_s.description: Past this the Stop gate asks Claude once to run the typecheck scoped, then stops blocking (default: 150).

py_lint_cmd.title: Python lint command
py_lint_cmd.description: Run by the Stop gate when Python files matching the Python path regex changed, e.g. ruff check services/agent-service (default: ruff check .).

py_dir_regex.title: Python path regex
py_dir_regex.description: Changed paths matching this trigger the Python lint (default: \.py$, i.e. any Python file).

local_checks.title: Local checks (display)
local_checks.description: One line listing the repo's check commands, shown in the session banner so Claude never guesses them.

eslint_fix_on_edit.title: Run eslint --fix on each edit
eslint_fix_on_edit.description: 1 (default) runs eslint --fix on the edited TS/JS file; 0 skips it (type-aware eslint configs can take seconds per file).
